references.text: The angel of the Lord also appears to Moses at the burning bush, a similar call to service
God promises to be with Joshua, the same assurance given to Gideon: 'The Lord is with you'
Joshua is called to be brave and strong, similar to the description of Gideon as 'you mighty warrior'
David is described as a 'warrior', the same expression used for Gideon: 'gibor hechayil'
Boaz is called 'gibor chayil' - a mighty man of worth, the same Hebrew expression
The angel greets Mary with 'The Lord is with you', the same greeting the angel of the Lord gives to Gideon
Immanuel means 'God with us', reflecting the promise 'The Lord is with you' given to Gideon
Jesus promises, 'I am with you all days', the same assurance of God's presence given to Gideon
